Alex (CEO): Quick micro-brief — three focal points this week: 1) Close reliability gaps in EU region (target: reduce p99 errors by 30%); 2) drive another 5% reduction in token cost using Optimize and targeted quantization; 3) get Private GA readiness checklist green by Friday. Keep scope small and reversible. :rocket:

Priya (VP Product): Noted. Product freeze starts Thu 18:00 UTC. I'll post the freeze checklist in #product and link the sheet. @Jamie please confirm CS comms plan. :eyes:

Miguel (VP Eng): Plan: rolling kernel patch Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC, will route traffic to secondary pools during the window. Canary on Fri 09:00 UTC with ~5% traffic. Reserving +15% dedicated capacity for the canary. Action: tag model versions you rely on with `model.pin('v2026-03-21')` for stability.

Sam (SRE): Heads-up — small regression in seq-cache misses after last week's rollout. I'll run a pre-canary smoke that exercises 512-token workloads. Abort if failure >0.5%. Adding alert for kv-cache eviction spikes.

Jamie (Customer Success): I'll share the GA notification draft in #customer-success by EOD today. Two enterprise customers requested extra validation; looping in Sales for signoff.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: kernel-patch-2026-03-25 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-25T05:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled.

Alex (CEO): Thanks — keep updates short. If anything risky crops up, call a quick bridge. :phone: :thumbsup:

Priya (VP Product): Understood. Posting checklist now: https://redwood.example.com/private-ga-checklist

Miguel (VP Eng): Acknowledged. I'll post the canary playbook and abort criteria in #eng-runtime later today.
